description.text: A concept pack of the XY series released on 18 July 2015, the day Hoopa's film opened in Japan, gathering Hoopa and the legendary Pokémon that appear in it. Every card is holo, and each four-card pack held a Pokémon-EX, Hoopa-EX or Pikachu-EX, or a legendary Pokémon drawn across the whole card, such as Reshiram, Dialga or Arceus. It came in two wrappers holding the same cards. The cards are numbered to 27.
